label: Kintone
description: Automate app records, comments, process actions and cursor exports

operations.name: get_app
operations.description: Get general app information, including its name.

operations.name: get_fields
operations.description: Get field codes, types and settings.

operations.name: get_views
operations.description: Get the app's configured views.

operations.name: get_process
operations.description: Get process management states and actions.

operations.name: get_record
operations.description: Read a record by its numeric ID.

operations.name: list_records
operations.description: Read one page. Use Kintone query syntax with limit (max 500) and offset (max 10000), or use cursors for larger exports.

operations.name: create_record
operations.description: Add one record with field codes mapped to value objects.

operations.name: update_record
operations.description: Update specified fields of one record, optionally checking its revision.

operations.name: create_records
operations.description: Add up to 100 records in one request.

operations.name: update_records
operations.description: Update up to 100 records by ID in one request.

operations.name: delete_records
operations.description: Delete up to 100 records. Revisions, when supplied, correspond to IDs in order.

operations.name: get_comments
operations.description: Read one page of comments; newer and older indicate remaining pages.

operations.name: add_comment
operations.description: Add a comment and optional user, group or organization mentions.

operations.name: delete_comment
operations.description: Delete one comment by ID.

operations.name: create_cursor
operations.description: Create an export cursor. The query accepts conditions only, without order by, limit or offset.

operations.name: get_cursor
operations.description: Read the next cursor page; repeat until next is false. Reading advances the cursor.

operations.name: delete_cursor
operations.description: Delete an unfinished export cursor.

operations.name: update_status
operations.description: Run a configured process action, optionally choosing the next assignee.

operations.name: update_assignees
operations.description: Replace process assignees; an empty list clears them.

operations.name: on_new_record
operations.description:
Watch an app for new records. Existing records become the initial baseline.

    Polls all accessible records, up to 10,000; larger apps fail without advancing
    the baseline. The API token needs View records permission for this app.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_record
operations.description:
Watch for new records or changes to their accessible field values.

    Polling compares complete records between runs; intermediate edits between
    polls and changes to fields the token cannot view are not delivered.
    Supports apps with at most 10,000 accessible records.
